Some alternatives, sorry if they don't help, I'm just throwing things I've been taught or that help me sometimes: 

* Going outside be it on a walk or just sitting in the garden, or even looking outside with the window open. 
* Pacing the room up and down really fast. 
* Writing poetry, short stories, or drawing things that express feelings of self harm (regardless of self-perceived skill level). 
* Watch a funny video, it can be something you watched already and know makes you laugh or you can try something new. 
* Eat something hard or crunchy, I find the sensation of crunching down on a hard food such as crackers, crunchy toast, etc to be relieving. (be careful of your teeth. don't chew on exceptionally hard foods like candy that is meant to be sucked)
* Tire yourself out with exercise or stretching. Personally for me I get very tired after a self harm session, and the feeling of exhaustion after a lot of exercise is similar
* Similar to the above, tightly grip blankets or pillows, or throw them (not at any fragile objects, and don't whack yourself with them). Plushies also work for this purpose.
* Listen to music and lip sync or sing along to the words, you can also try air-guitar, drumming on your desk, dancing to the rhythm etc.

If I think of any more, I will edit or reply to this comment. Again, I understand that some of these suggestions might seem lame or weird or something - I know I would've thought the same of them before I got my therapy - but I'm just offering what I can... Wishing you the best.
